pages.text: Hunt these in Overworld structures. Iron or copper gear is enough if you dodge actively.$(br2)Several drop a $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)unique weapon$(/l). Every kill banks Combat tokens and counts toward your $(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() boss-rush clear.$(br2)The boss compass and bonfire waystones point you to arenas as you discover them.

pages.title: Mutant Monsters
pages.text: $(bold)Mutant Zombie$() (Overworld surface and structures). Drops: $(item)Hulk Hammer$() (25%; 20 attack damage, 0.5 attack speed, Knockback II, +50% vs undead), Uncommon Ink (20%), Blood Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() (Overworld surface). Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Ice Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() (Overworld surface). Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Fire Rune (10%).

pages.title: Structure Bosses
pages.text: $(bold)Terramity$(): $(item)Gob, King of Gnomes$() ({{boss terramity:gob place}}; summon him with an emerald) and $(item)Super Sniffer$() (Ancient Outcrop). Enchanter Merlin is a Tier 3 boss (the Nether's Chthonic Cathedral).$(br2)$(bold)Mowzie's Mobs$(): Ferrous Wroughtnaut (underground chamber), Umvuthi (savanna), the Sculptor (mountain peaks), Naga (coastal cliffs). Frostmaw is in Everbright instead (Tier 2).

pages.title: Mini-Bosses
pages.text: $(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$() casters walk the Overworld too, but the Archevoker and its kin are {{boss irons_spellbooks:archevoker tier}} bosses, so their tokens and boss rush are Tier 3's.$(br2)$(bold)Brutal Bosses$(): champion-level mobs guarding Overworld dungeons, with loot of their own. They are on no kill roster, so they pay no Codex tokens.

pages.title: Mini-Bosses, cont.
pages.text: $(note)Mutant Monsters crafting recipes are removed: the Hulk Hammer and the rune and ink drops are the intended T1 rewards.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft codex bosses to see your clear count.$()
